subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Geisha: The $1,000 Pound of Coffee
description: Learn Geisha: The $1,000 Pound of Coffee in one minute.

hook.text: Geisha variety coffee from Panama set world records—selling for over $1,000 per pound at auction.

buildup.text: Geisha originated in Ethiopian forests near the town of Gesha. It was rediscovered in Panama's Hacienda La Esmeralda.

discovery.text: Its flavor is unlike any other coffee—jasmine, bergamot, and tropical fruit. Judges had never tasted anything like it.

twist.text: Geisha plants produce less volume and are harder to grow. Most farmers can't afford the risk of low-yield crops.

climax.text: The Geisha phenomenon proved that coffee can reach luxury-product pricing—if quality is extraordinary enough.

punchline.text: One variety, one farm, one record-breaking cup. Quality has no ceiling.

quiz.question: Where was the Geisha coffee variety rediscovered?
